links.comparator_used: Same models before bias mitigation (baseline without fairness-specific mitigation)
links.outcome: Fairness metrics (disparate impact, equal opportunity difference, false favourable rates by sex)
links.effect: Disparate impact 0.80 to 0.95; equal opportunity difference 0.20 to 0.05; false favourable rate for males 0.0059 to 0.0033 and for females 0.0096 to 0.0064
links.tradeoff: No accuracy cost reported; the authors note computational complexity in large-scale data processing as a limitation.
links.quote: Bias mitigation improved disparate impact (0.80 to 0.95), reduced equal opportunity difference (0.20 to 0.05), and decreased false favourable rates for males (0.0059 to 0.0033) and females (0.0096 to 0.0064) through balanced probability adjustment.

design_hint: fairness-aware bias mitigation (debiasing, equalised odds post-processing)
